payload.summary: Reviewed the complete queue-projection implementation and fixed five contract defects with RED-to-GREEN tests. Persist ordering, reconciliation authorization, bridge failure envelopes, reserved-key isolation, and CLI failure parity now match the approved specification; all available local gates pass.
completed_work: Enforced submit_work authorization for direct reconciliation
Rejected reserved projection identity on unkeyed submissions
Removed success-only fields from CLI failure envelopes

decisions.title: Treat projection persistence and transport parity as merge-blocking contracts
decisions.rationale: The queue is derived state, so missed post-persistence publication or transport-specific authorization behavior breaks crash recovery and boundary consistency.

next_steps: Run validation with a real PostgreSQL service when available
Proceed to implementation review using the committed local evidence
